title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
summary: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
summary: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating, and at today’s prices each one earns slightly more than the electricity it burns.

title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end

title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
summary: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.
